leadStory: Alexander Isak scored twice inside the first nine minutes at Portman Road on Friday night and Liverpool beat Ipswich Town 2-0, Andoni Iraola's first win at the third attempt, the first time his side has led a game this season and its first clean sheet since April. Both goals came from Cody Gakpo through-balls, the first driven in at the near post in the sixth minute, the second slid in left-footed in the ninth; a third was disallowed for offside in the 33rd. Ronald Araujo made a first start, at right-back ahead of Frimpong; Bradley Barcola made his debut from the bench on 64 minutes. FotMob had Ipswich ahead on expected goals, 0.73 to 0.66. Liverpool rise to fifth on five points. Atletico Madrid at Anfield on Wednesday next.
